run_simple_agents_cli: run the simple_agents module as a CLI to evaluate navigation agents with configurable agent class and task config
create_RandomAgent: create a RandomAgent instance that randomly chooses move forward, turn left, or turn right actions
create_ForwardOnlyAgent: create a ForwardOnlyAgent that always moves forward until the goal distance threshold is reached
create_GoalFollower: create a GoalFollower agent that turns towards the goal and moves forward when aligned within 15 degrees
get_agent_cls: get an agent class by name from all subclasses of habitat.Agent using the get_agent_cls function
